description: How the requirements that no test in this repository names are checked. 'internal': by Hakoniwa Lab's internal tests (test IDs given), whose publication is in preparation. 'per-sensor': by each sensor's tests, as the test design states. 'review': by code review, recorded in docs/reviews.md. 'retired': no longer a requirement. 'none': no test yet. 'tested' with 'tests': the tests that check it. Used by tools/traceability.py.
